strings.msz.title: Station Zero
strings.msz.tagline: You get off in a station that does not exist on any map. Frozen platforms, strange announcements, a Zero ticket, and shifting corridors lead you toward a place that seems to be waiting for your arrival.
strings.msz.s01.title: Get off without looking
strings.msz.s01.body: You step off the train without looking up. When you raise your head, the platform is empty, too cold, too clean. The silence feels wrong.
strings.msz.s01.c2: Run along the platform toward an exit
strings.msz.s01.c3: Go back toward the train already far away
strings.msz.s02.title: The train pulls away
strings.msz.s02.body: The train pulls away and disappears into the tunnel. The platform stays silent. Nothing moves.
strings.msz.s02.c2: Stare at the passenger information sign
strings.msz.s02.c3: Look for people, anyone at all
strings.msz.s03.title: The empty platform
strings.msz.s03.body: Metal benches, torn posters, fine dust… but no sign of recent life. You feel like you arrived too late.
strings.msz.s03.c2: Follow the platform toward a corridor
strings.msz.s04.title: Unknown sign
strings.msz.s04.body: The lit sign crackles. A name appears, then warps: "STATION ZERO." The time displayed seems correct… and that makes it worse.
strings.msz.s04.c2: Look for a poster or an instruction
strings.msz.s05.title: Looking for people
strings.msz.s05.body: You move forward while calling out. The sound of your voice comes back too quickly, as if the place were narrower than it should be. No one answers.
strings.msz.s05.c3: Go back to the center of the platform
strings.msz.s06.title: Emergency button
strings.msz.s06.body: Under a speaker grille, there is a red button. The dust is untouched… except for one small clean circle, as if someone pressed it recently.
strings.msz.s07.title: The speaker answers
strings.msz.s07.body: A hiss, then a neutral voice: "Traveler detected. Next descent: you." It sounds like a recorded message.
strings.msz.s07.c2: Ignore it and move toward the corridors
strings.msz.s08.title: "Next descent"
strings.msz.s08.body: On a wall of posters, a fresh sheet has been pasted over the others: "NEXT DESCENT: YOU." The ink is fresh. Someone is still printing here.
strings.msz.s08.c3: Go back to the lit sign
strings.msz.s09.title: Back to the platform
strings.msz.s09.body: You return to the platform. It looks longer than before, as if the perspective stretched while you were looking elsewhere.
strings.msz.s09.c2: Watch the tunnel and the train
strings.msz.s09.c3: Go back to the lit sign
strings.msz.s10.title: Main corridor
strings.msz.s10.body: A standard corridor, like in any normal station. But here, every door looks the same. It feels wrong.
strings.msz.s11.title: Direction "Exit"
strings.msz.s11.body: Arrows point toward the exit. But some do not point the same way. You have to choose: follow the signs or your instinct.
strings.msz.s11.c3: Step back and do not follow
strings.msz.s12.title: Frozen escalator
strings.msz.s12.body: The escalator is still. At the top, everything is drowned in shadow. An "EXIT" sign points in two directions.
strings.msz.s12.c2: Go to the restroom to pull yourself together
strings.msz.s12.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s13.title: Turnstiles
strings.msz.s13.body: The turnstiles are there. The readers are dark… except for one red light, alive, attentive. You feel like it is looking at you like an eye.
strings.msz.s14.title: Red reader
strings.msz.s14.body: The reader briefly shows a message: "VALIDATE PASSAGE." Then: "DO NOT GO BACK UP." It feels like the station is giving you instructions.
strings.msz.s14.c1: Go back to look for a ticket
strings.msz.s14.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s15.title: Barred exit
strings.msz.s15.body: A metal gate blocks the way. A new chain. A sign reads "Station out of service." On the other side, there is almost nothing. Just a gray emptiness.
strings.msz.s16.title: Going back
strings.msz.s16.body: You turn around. The corridor seems slightly different, as if the tiles had changed shade. Enough to make you doubt your memory.
strings.msz.s16.c2: Go back to the network map
strings.msz.s17.title: Lit ticket machine
strings.msz.s17.body: An old ticket machine is lit up. A ticket is already sticking halfway out, ready to be taken. As if the station printed it for you before you even arrived.
strings.msz.s17.c2: Ignore it and go to the map
strings.msz.s18.title: "ZERO" ticket
strings.msz.s18.body: The ticket is warm. On it: a single number, "0." No station. No date. Just that number, like a key without any visible lock.
strings.msz.s19.title: Network map
strings.msz.s19.body: The map shows the lines. But one section has been torn off. Someone removed an area from the map.
strings.msz.s19.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s20.title: Torn section
strings.msz.s20.body: The missing part looks like a hidden station. Behind the paper, a pencil note says: "ZERO = LEVEL." The rest has been scratched out.
strings.msz.s20.c1: Go back to the map to assemble it later
strings.msz.s20.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s21.title: Restroom
strings.msz.s21.body: The restroom is dirty just enough… as if someone tried to imitate wear. The neon light hums. The mirror is cracked.
strings.msz.s21.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s22.title: Delayed mirror
strings.msz.s22.body: Your reflection moves a fraction of a second late. Not enough to be an easy hallucination. Just enough to make you want to stop looking at yourself.
strings.msz.s22.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s23.title: Secondary corridor
strings.msz.s23.body: Here, the air is colder. The doors are identical, but some bear marks: chalk, scratches, a repeated symbol. They look like signs left by someone.
strings.msz.s23.c3: Go down to a lower level
strings.msz.s24.title: Graffiti arrow
strings.msz.s24.body: A crude arrow points toward "SERVICE." The paint is recent. On the floor, a chalk mark shows you where to place your feet.
strings.msz.s24.c2: Go to the "Lost and Found" office
strings.msz.s24.c3: Go back to the secondary corridor
strings.msz.s25.title: SERVICE door
strings.msz.s25.body: Metal door marked "SERVICE." Flaking paint. Badge reader. The handle bears a deep gouge, as if someone tried to force it open.
strings.msz.s25.c2: Go down to the lower level
strings.msz.s26.title: Listening behind it
strings.msz.s26.body: Ear against the metal. A faint sound: cables, ventilation… then a strange breath, almost like a voice.
strings.msz.s26.c1: Look for access through the locker room
strings.msz.s26.c2: Go down to the lower level
strings.msz.s27.title: Level -1
strings.msz.s27.body: A staircase leads down. The sign says "No access." The steps are damp, as if no one maintains this place. You realize everything here pushes you lower.
strings.msz.s27.c2: Go toward a technical locker room
strings.msz.s27.c3: Go back up to the corridor
strings.msz.s28.title: Flooded passage
strings.msz.s28.body: Water sits in a low corridor. Black reflections, smell of metal. Something floats gently there, as if it had been left for you.
strings.msz.s29.title: Floating object
strings.msz.s29.body: You make out a piece of plastic and warped paper… and you immediately do not want to put your hand in that water.
strings.msz.s29.c2: Look for tunnel access farther ahead
strings.msz.s30.title: Technical locker room
strings.msz.s30.body: Lockers. A fluorescent vest hangs from a hook. And a badge with a name on it is hanging there, perfectly visible. Like an invitation that is too convenient.
strings.msz.s31.title: The hanging badge
strings.msz.s31.body: The badge is really there. Worn plastic. A name. A photo too blurry. And yet, you can feel it has weight here. Like real authorization.
strings.msz.s32.title: Back to the corridor
strings.msz.s32.body: You return to the secondary corridor. It is identical. Nothing has changed.
strings.msz.s32.c1: Go toward the silhouette you saw
strings.msz.s32.c2: Go to the lost and found office
strings.msz.s33.title: Silhouette at the end
strings.msz.s33.body: At the end of the corridor, a blurry silhouette. Its back is turned to you. It does not move… then it disappears around a corner.
strings.msz.s33.c2: Go to the lost and found office instead
strings.msz.s34.title: Follow or flee
strings.msz.s34.body: You hesitate. Run after it or turn back. You feel like you are losing time.
strings.msz.s34.c2: Go to the lost and found office
strings.msz.s34.c3: Go back to the secondary corridor
strings.msz.s35.title: "Lost and Found" office
strings.msz.s35.body: A small office. Drawers, stamps, forms. A green lamp lights an open register, as if someone just left it in a hurry.
strings.msz.s36.title: Register of the missing
strings.msz.s36.body: Pages and pages. Names. Stations. And sometimes just "0." The last lines are blank, but one space already seems ready for a new name.
strings.msz.s36.c3: Go back to the start of the office
strings.msz.s37.title: "DESCENT" stamp
strings.msz.s37.body: One stamp carries a single word: "DESCENT." The handle is worn by nervous hands. It feels like a rule of this place, not just a tool.
strings.msz.s37.c3: Go back into the office to look again
strings.msz.s38.title: The station files you away
strings.msz.s38.body: The lit sign comes back to your mind: "Traveler detected." Here, you finally understand: you are not lost. You are registered.
strings.msz.s38.c2: Go back toward the main corridor
strings.msz.s38.c3: Go back to the fresh posters
strings.msz.s39.title: Tunnel access
strings.msz.s39.body: A technical opening leads into a narrow tunnel. Cables, pipes, condensation. The air changes at times. As if something were moving inside the walls.
strings.msz.s39.c2: Look for a door leading to control
strings.msz.s39.c3: Go back to the secondary corridor
strings.msz.s40.title: The tunnel breathes
strings.msz.s40.body: The farther you go, the more you feel watched. As if someone were following your every move.
strings.msz.s41.title: Door to control
strings.msz.s41.body: A door opens into a control room. It is not locked. The most unsettling part is that you can enter without any difficulty.
strings.msz.s42.title: Control room
strings.msz.s42.body: Old consoles. Old cathode screens. Dim indicators. An empty chair faces a central station, as if someone were waiting for you here.
strings.msz.s43.title: Silent screens
strings.msz.s43.body: The screens show lines, diagrams, then freeze. You feel like the place has turned its attention toward you.
strings.msz.s43.c2: Try returning to the platform through the station
strings.msz.s43.c3: Go back to the control room
strings.msz.s44.title: Delayed video
strings.msz.s44.body: A wall of screens. One camera shows the platform… with a slight delay. You see yourself moving a second too late. If you record this, you will keep real proof.
strings.msz.s44.c3: Go back to the control room
strings.msz.s45.title: Start a recording
strings.msz.s45.body: You record the screen. The sound is almost absent, but a breath gets captured. It sounds like that noise comes directly from the station.
strings.msz.s45.c2: Return to the platform with this proof
strings.msz.s45.c3: Go back to the control room
strings.msz.s46.title: Impossible date
strings.msz.s46.body: The displayed date is not normal. Something is wrong.
strings.msz.s46.c3: Go back to the control room
strings.msz.s47.title: Back to the platform
strings.msz.s47.body: You return to the platform. You understand that the station let you come back here on purpose.
strings.msz.s47.c1: Wait to see if a train returns
strings.msz.s47.c3: Go back toward the control door
strings.msz.s48.title: The train returns
strings.msz.s48.body: A train arrives through the tunnel. The doors open. It seems empty.
strings.msz.s49.title: Open doors
strings.msz.s49.body: The doors are open. Inside, it is almost dark. You feel that if you board, you are doing more than stepping into a train. You are accepting something.
strings.msz.s50.title: Personalized announcement
strings.msz.s50.body: The speaker crackles: "Traveler: confirmed. Descent: validated." Then a breath: "You can still refuse… but you will come back."
strings.msz.s50.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s51.title: Refuse to board
strings.msz.s51.body: You refuse. The platform feels even colder. The place seems to react badly to your choice.
strings.msz.s51.c1: Take up the network map again
strings.msz.s51.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s52.title: Take up the map again
strings.msz.s52.body: You stand before the map again. Without the fragment, it gives you nothing but dizziness. With the fragment, you can understand a hidden direction.
strings.msz.s52.c2: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s53.title: Assemble the fragment
strings.msz.s53.body: The piece lines up perfectly. A hidden line appears. It leads toward "SERVICE — CONTROL — EXIT."
strings.msz.s53.c2: Go back to the fresh poster
strings.msz.s53.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s54.title: Looping corridor
strings.msz.s54.body: You move forward… and come back to the same place. There is no way out like this.
strings.msz.s54.c1: Go look at the fresh poster
strings.msz.s54.c2: Go back to the graffiti arrow
strings.msz.s54.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s55.title: Same poster, fresher
strings.msz.s55.body: The same poster: "NEXT DESCENT: YOU," but even fresher. As if it had been put up just before your arrival.
strings.msz.s55.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s56.title: Find the right arrow
strings.msz.s56.body: Several arrows. Only one seems to lead elsewhere. The others feel like they send you back to the same place.
strings.msz.s56.c1: Go to the SERVICE badge reader
strings.msz.s57.title: Service: badge reader
strings.msz.s57.body: The reader is waiting. Without a badge, nothing happens. With the badge, you might be able to open it.
strings.msz.s57.c2: Go back and listen at the door
strings.msz.s58.title: Open with the badge
strings.msz.s58.body: Beep. The SERVICE door opens slightly. Behind it: the smell of maintenance, hot dust, and electricity.
strings.msz.s58.c2: Go back to the maintenance tunnel
strings.msz.s59.title: Deep tunnel
strings.msz.s59.body: The tunnel goes deeper. Cables, pipes, condensation. Sometimes you hear a click far ahead, like a mechanism being triggered farther on.
strings.msz.s59.c3: Go back toward the SERVICE door
strings.msz.s60.title: Technical cabinet
strings.msz.s60.body: An open cabinet. Inside it, there is a small service key. You understand it can open a real exit.
strings.msz.s61.title: Take the service key
strings.msz.s61.body: The key is cold and heavy. It feels very old.
strings.msz.s61.c2: Go back to the control room
strings.msz.s61.c3: Go back toward the control door
strings.msz.s62.title: Back toward the turnstiles
strings.msz.s62.body: You return to the turnstiles. The red light is still on.
strings.msz.s62.c2: Go back toward the exit gate
strings.msz.s62.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s63.title: Try the ZERO ticket
strings.msz.s63.body: You present the "0" ticket. Without it, nothing happens. With it, the station recognizes you.
strings.msz.s64.title: The gate moves
strings.msz.s64.body: A clicking sound is heard. The chain loosens a little. But something is still missing.
strings.msz.s64.c2: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s65.title: "EXIT" corridor
strings.msz.s65.body: Behind a plain door, a corridor marked "EXIT." The air changes. It feels drier, more normal.
strings.msz.s65.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s66.title: Outside staircase
strings.msz.s66.body: Steps go upward. No posters. No neon lights. Just a gray light above.
strings.msz.s67.title: Real air… almost
strings.msz.s67.body: The air is cold, but it feels more normal. You feel like you are finally getting closer to the outside.
strings.msz.s68.title: Last doubt
strings.msz.s68.body: You see the exit. You can leave. But you hesitate. Is it the right exit?
strings.msz.s68.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s69.title: Back to control
strings.msz.s69.body: You return to control. The screens seem to be waiting for you, as if the station were giving you one last choice: leave or stay.
strings.msz.s69.c3: Go back to the main corridor
strings.msz.s70.title: Operator console
strings.msz.s70.body: One station has a small plaque: "OPERATOR." The chair is perfectly aligned. You understand that someone has to sit there. Maybe you.
strings.msz.s70.c1: Place your evidence on the console
strings.msz.s71.title: Set down the evidence
strings.msz.s71.body: You place what you have on the console. Some things matter more than others here: the ticket, the key, and the recording. The rest is not enough.
strings.msz.s71.c1: Validate at least one solid piece of evidence
strings.msz.s71.c2: Validate everything to understand the full truth
strings.msz.s72.title: Choose: leave or stay
strings.msz.s72.body: Far away, the lit sign still flashes: "STATION ZERO." The station lets you choose. You understand that your decision truly matters.
strings.msz.s72.c1: Go back to the platform to decide
strings.msz.s73.title: The station waits
strings.msz.s73.body: You return toward the platform. Everything is even emptier. The silence is heavy. It feels like the place is waiting for your choice.
strings.msz.s74.title: The platform fades again
strings.msz.s74.body: You feel like the station is slowly erasing everything around you.
strings.msz.s75.title: The final choice
strings.msz.s75.body: You have seen enough to understand one thing: here, every choice has a price.
strings.msz.s75.c3: Force the station and seek the revelation
strings.msz.end_good.title: Ending — Real exit
strings.msz.end_good.body: You get out. Dawn is gray, cold, real. Whether you keep proof or only doubt, one thing remains certain: Station Zero was not a dream. One impossible detail near the entrance confirms it. You are outside. And this time, the station does not hold you back anymore.
strings.msz.end_bad.title: Ending — The descent continues
strings.msz.end_bad.body: You board. The doors close. The light inside the car wipes away your last hesitation. When you look through the window, the platform is no longer a platform. It is a corridor. Then a blank page. And you understand: you are no longer a traveler. You have become a file.
strings.msz.end_secret.title: Secret ending — Active operator
strings.msz.end_secret.body: The required evidence lines up. The station stabilizes and reveals its real function: sorting, validating, assigning. The screens display: "ACTIVE OPERATOR." The chair is waiting for you. Then you understand that the next announcement will come from you.
strings.msz.h.s11.soft: The signs do not guide you: they test what you follow.
strings.msz.h.s11.strong: Find a way to get a "0" ticket: it is a form of access recognition.
strings.msz.h.s14.soft: The red reader is not an obstacle: it is a judgment.
strings.msz.h.s14.strong: Without the "0" ticket, the station will not open anything for you. Go back to the ticket machine.
strings.msz.h.s34.soft: Some presences are there to distract you, not to kill you.
strings.msz.h.s34.strong: The tunnel and control room provide useful evidence, like the badge or the recording.
strings.msz.h.s54.soft: If you end up in the same place, the station has taken you back.
strings.msz.h.s54.strong: Assemble the map fragment: it reveals the real route toward SERVICE, then toward EXIT.
strings.msz.h.s57.soft: The station lets through those who have the right role.
strings.msz.h.s57.strong: Take the badge from the locker room: it opens SERVICE and unlocks progression.
strings.msz.h.s68.soft: The exit is not only a door: it is a version of you.
strings.msz.h.s68.strong: To get out, avoid the train. The evidence helps you understand the station, but it should not be required for the exit.
strings.msz.h.s72.strong: The train leads to the bad ending. The EXIT corridor leads to the real way out.
strings.msz.clue.has_map_fragment.title: Map fragment
strings.msz.clue.has_name_tag.title: Badge with name
strings.msz.clue.has_phone_recording.title: Recorded video
strings.msz.clue.has_service_key.title: Service key
strings.msz.clue.has_zero_ticket.title: Zero ticket
